instruction: Could you assist me in removing the dark mode setting from Google Chrome? The dark background is causing issues with screen recording, as the videos appear too dim and the UI elements are barely visible in the recordings.

metadata.explanation: Task variation focuses on removing Chrome dark mode for screen recording visibility. Marked as infeasible because Chrome dark mode settings cannot be reliably automated and verified in the OSWorld environment, and screen recording quality checks are beyond the evaluation scope.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible - the infeasible() function is a valid evaluator for non-automatable tasks
Chrome dark mode settings involve system-level preferences and browser themes that cannot be reliably verified programmatically
Screen recording quality assessment (videos too dim, UI elements barely visible) requires subjective visual evaluation beyond OSWorld's capabilities
No feasible getter/metric combination exists to verify both dark mode removal AND screen recording quality improvement
The metadata explanation correctly identifies why this task cannot be automated or verified
